parameters.name: CycleTime
parameters.description:
The time of the cycle.

- If CycleType is set to Month, specify the day of the month. Valid values: 1 to 28. Use commas (,) to separate multiple days.

- If CycleType is set to Week, specify the day of the week. Valid values: 1 to 7. Use commas (,) to separate multiple days.

parameters.name: CycleType
parameters.description:
The cycle type. Valid values:

- Month

- Week

parameters.name: MaintainEndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the maintenance window. Use the HH:mmZ format. The time is in UTC.

parameters.name: MaintainStartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the task. The time must be in UTC and in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the configuration. Valid values: 1 (Enable) and 2 (Disable).
